newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC COMPLETES DEAL ON ARGENTINA'S ROBERTS.
newsitem.headline: HSBC COMPLETES DEAL ON ARGENTINA'S ROBERTS.

text.p: Banking giant HSBC Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it had completed the acquisition of Argentina's Roberts S.A. de Inversiones, a private financial services holding company including Banco Roberts S.A.
The Hong Kong-based banking concern said in a statement it intends to rename the Argentine group HSBC Roberts S.A. de Inversiones, and its principle banking subsidiary Banco HSBC Roberts S.A.
HSBC has held 29.9 percent of Banco Roberts since 1988.
Enrique Ruete, formerly chief executive of the Roberts Group, has been appointed chairman of HSBC Roberts Group.
Mike Smith, formerly deputy chief executive officer of HSBC's Hongkong Bank Malaysia, has been appointed group chief executive officer of HSBC Roberts Group.
In May, HSBC announced the acquisition of Roberts Group for between US$600 and US$688 million.
